consequence.statement: No operational consequence for operators who do nothing: spec.refreshPolicy is a newly available optional field in the ExternalSecret v1beta1 schema, and the evidence states only its addition (with a description of the CreatedOnce/Periodic/OnChange refresh behaviors it selects), not any change to existing resources.

assertion.statement: Between 0.15.0 and 0.16.0, the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema of ExternalSecret (externalsecrets.external-secrets.io) gained a new field spec.refreshPolicy, whose schema description selects how the ExternalSecret is refreshed (CreatedOnce, Periodic, OnChange).
